subject: Subprocessor curation + cross-border transfer clarifications
messages:
From: Alice Liu <alice.liu@paymate.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subcontractor roster + transfer zones for PayMate pilot

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal/privacy at PayMate asked me to pull together the list of subprocessors Redwood will rely on for our integration (telemetry, logs, embedding compute, caching). Can you send the current roster and indicate:

- Which subprocessors process or transit EU/UK personal data vs. US-only?
- Any temporary/transient processors (e.g., edge caches) that may have cross-border egress?
- Whether you have onshore fallback options for observability/telemetry if we require EU residency for logs?

If possible, please attach your latest subprocessor checklist and a simple dataflow diagram — privacy has a tight June onboarding window. Also copying our security mailbox (security@paymate.com) for evidence requests.

Appreciate it —
Alice Liu
Senior Procurement Manager, PayMate
alice.liu@paymate.com

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alice Liu <alice.liu@paymate.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subcontractor roster + transfer zones for PayMate pilot

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the note and the timeline. See attached: the subprocessor checklist (paymate-subprocessor-checklist.xlsx) and a simplified dataflow diagram (dataflow-diagram-v2.pdf). High-level answers below:

- EU/UK processing: Observability (EdgeSight), telemetry ingestion (Telemetriq), and embedding hosting (ModelFarm EU shard) are the primary components that touch EU/UK personal data for PayMate's configuration.
- Transient processors: Several edge caches (EdgeRelay instances) in our CDN layer may transiently egress data across regions when a local node lacks cache or for cache warming. We list those as temporary/ephemeral in the checklist.
- Onshore fallback: We can enable onshore telemetry routing (EU-only) for logs/metrics and an onshore embeddings shard for customers who require residency; this requires a short config change and an SOC attestation amendment for the DPA appendix.

Internal note to @kimberly_park and @laura_bennett: can you confirm the EdgeRelay replacement status (was planning doc that retired EdgeRelay in favor of EdgeWave in Q1) — we should not list EdgeRelay as active if decommissioning completed. Also, please confirm whether the ModelFarm EU shard has the new encryption-at-rest key scoping we discussed (KMS partition).

I included our Drive link for the architecture doc and PRIV-742 which tracks the attestation change. Let me know if PayMate needs a signed appendix or additional evidence (S3 snapshot of config, onshore routing runbook).

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: paymate-subprocessor-checklist.xlsx (stated), dataflow-diagram-v2.pdf (stated)

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subcontractor roster + transfer zones for PayMate pilot

Stephanie / Laura —

Quick correction for the checklist before we send the final: EdgeRelay was fully retired 2027-02-28 and replaced with EdgeWave (note: EdgeWave routes are region-aware and have a stronger egress control). I updated the checklist tab "transient_processors" to reflect EdgeWave and added a short note about cache-warming egress behavior (rows 12-14).

Also confirmed with infra that ModelFarm EU shard is scoped to the EU KMS partition as of 2027-03-03 (so encryption-at-rest boundaries align). We should include a short line in the email to PayMate: "ModelFarm EU shard uses EU KMS partition — key material never leaves region."

If PayMate wants a formal attestation amendment to the DPA, that goes through Legal — I can draft the proposed appendix language and route for signature if you want.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: subcontractor roster + transfer zones for PayMate pilot

Hi Alice —

Following up with the corrected materials attached. Key callouts for PayMate:

1) EdgeWave (replacement for EdgeRelay) is listed as the CDN edge caching partner; cache-warming may transiently egress, but routing is region-aware and we can restrict EU customers to EU-only nodes.
2) ModelFarm EU shard is scoped to the EU KMS partition (encryption-at-rest keys do not leave the EU).
3) Telemetriq and EdgeSight are our telemetry/observability processors — we can enable EU-only routing for PayMate’s tenant.

Attachments included: paymate-subprocessor-checklist.xlsx (updated), dataflow-diagram-v2.pdf (annotated).

Next steps: if PayMate requires a signed DPA appendix attesting to the EU onshore fallback and KMS partitioning I can work with Kimberly to produce draft language for Legal and route for signature. Also copying Marissa from Sales Ops to coordinate procurement timeline; we know you mentioned a June window.

Please confirm whether this set of artifacts satisfies your privacy team or if they prefer a short joint call to walk through the dataflow.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
